title: weivel repo file
description: What a repository says about itself, kept at .weivel/repo.json: its import name, description, topics, where it sits in a checkout and which repositories it depends on, each by id.

$schema.description: Pointer at the published schema, for an editor's completion and validation.

format.description: The version of this document's shape.

importName.description: The name this repository is imported by, which is also the folder it sits in beside its dependents.
importName.fix: use lowercase words joined by single hyphens or dots, for example "config-ledger" or "api.http"

description.description: A short line saying what the repository is, for the host to show.

topics.description: Topics the repository is filed under on its host.

items.fix: use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 50 characters, for example "json-schema"

homepage.description: The address of the repository's home page.
homepage.fix: write a full address, for example "https://example.org"

settings.description: Settings the host should carry for this repository. A setting left out leaves the host alone.
settings.fix: keep to visibility, defaultBranch, issues and wiki

defaultBranch.description: The branch the host opens by default.

issues.description: Whether the host's issue tracker is on.

wiki.description: Whether the host's wiki is on.

place.description: The folder this repository sits in directly beneath the root of a checkout, for a repository that holds a family of others.
place.fix: write one folder name, for example "docs"

hosts.description: The owners this repository may be published under, each as a resolver and an account.

items.fix: write the owner as a resolver and an account, for example "github:forebay"

projects.description: The projects this repository's folder holds, each with a one line description, keyed by the project's folder name.
projects.fix: write each project as a name and a one line description

additionalProperties.description: What the project is, on one line.
additionalProperties.fix: write one line with no line break

claims.description: The owners whose folder this repository describes, each as a resolver and an account.

items.fix: write the owner as a resolver and an account, for example "github:forebay"

dependencies.description: The repositories this one builds against, each by id and pinned to a commit.
dependencies.fix: list each dependency with its id, importName and commit

items.fix: give id, importName and commit, and a path only when it differs from the default

id.description: The repository identity of the dependency, which survives a rename.
id.fix: write the id as a repository id, for example "github:123" or "gitea@git.example.com:12/runtime"

importName.description: The name the dependency is imported by.
importName.fix: use lowercase words joined by single hyphens or dots

commit.description: The commit of the dependency this repository builds against.
commit.fix: write the full 40 character lowercase commit hash

path.description: Where the dependency is checked out, relative to this repository. Defaults to siblings/<importName>. It starts with siblings/, contains no .., and its last segment must equal importName, which JSON Schema cannot compare, so a checkout enforces it.
path.fix: write a path beneath siblings/ that ends in the dependency's importName, for example "siblings/kernel"
